plugins.description: Slash commands for the human's side of the issue→PR pipeline FSM: read the next ai:ready PR's whole merge decision, then rule on a close-candidate, reject, raise a design question, or keep an issue open. Each wraps one pr-review-report call; none writes GitHub state itself.
